title: Not Futura, Not Times New Roman: This Is 2026's Most Popular Font On The Web - BGR
summary: Instead, the most popular font in 2026 is Apercu, a unique typeface designed by the UK-based Colophon foundry. Given the app's popularity, millions of people see these letters daily, so technically it's the most-viewed font in the world by sheer numbers.
